question: What can the retained source shape and alternative pre-window baselines establish about epoch305, before any controller retuning?
comparison_scope: Compare the same recorded post-window with these descriptive pre-baselines using the unchanged existing response margins. A different label is model sensitivity, not a new physical response or an acceptance verdict.
native_boundary: Run the unchanged hybrid arithmetic on inputs with identical aggregate error, phase and authority. This tests whether those inputs retain source-shape information; it does not apply a candidate command or simulate a counterfactual plant.
conditional_projection: Also project the unchanged arithmetic with zero FLL count residual and the recorded raw relative phase retained, explicitly conditional on assigning all four counts to a localized phase contribution. This is a model assumption, not a corrected observation or a proposed command.
physical_limits: The epoch305 case is retrospectively selected and already inspected, not independent prospective validation.
A localized count contribution cannot identify oscillator, reference or electrical origin.
Recorded post-application observations cannot stand in for a plant response to a different unissued command.
No raw span, phase epoch, reference acceptance tolerance or current operating threshold changes.
Any future candidate qualification requires its own frozen pre-acquisition contract and decision criteria.
